description: System-level tools for task finalization and error reporting.

submit_final_answer.description: Finalize the task. The 'summary' argument IS the final report the user sees — include all findings, tables, and analysis directly here.

summary.description: The final report itself. Include the complete output with all findings, tables, and analysis. This is what the user sees — not a description of what was done.

system_error.description: Internal tool used by the system to report malformed tool calls back to the agent.

complete_step.description: Call this when the current step's requirements have been satisfied. Marks it done and progresses to the next step in the task.

notes.description: Brief summary of what was accomplished in this step.
